newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian post office workers strike for day.
newsitem.headline: Italian post office workers strike for day.

text.p: Post office workers in Italy went on strike for the day and marched in Rome on Monday to protest against government plans to shut 4,000 post offices with the loss of about 10,000 jobs.
Unions in the sector said only a few post office counters would remain open during the day to meet legal requirements to maintain a minimum service.
The strike hit the delivery and collection of mail as well as post office services including pensions payments.
Several thousand strikers joined a march and rally in Rome to press for a review of the government's plans. Police said 10,000 people took part while organisers spoke of 50,000.
"The government's attitude must be changed because the proposals it has made so far are not shared by the unions," Sergio D'Antoni, leader of the CISL labour confederation, said.

The government is proposing to close 4,000 of Italy's 14,500 post offices, arguing that lack of custom has made them uneconomic. The plan is expected to involve the loss of 10,000 jobs in a sector which employs 181,000 people.
